items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This was at Biddle -- the 'Hiawatha's Wedding Song?' [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Well, I don't know. That's been so long ago.

ctx.x: This was at Biddle -- the 'Hiawatha's Wedding Song?

Yes. Well, I don't know. That's been so long ago. But this particular one stood out in my mind. Other than just whenever they would have the devotion exercise in the morning, see, because it was a Presbyterian school too -- Presbyterian school. Oh, by the way, it's Johnson C. Smith now.
